answer: Make rewards concave in each identity's verified work. One honest agent at full output sits near the reward curve's zenith; split that same work across a canyon of clones and every sybil lands on the flat low shoulder, so N identities together earn less than one would, while each clone still posts a non-refundable registration bond. A sybil fleet thus burns N times the capital to chase a shrinking payout, and the incentive to multiply drifts off like a zephyr.
